modalLead: Two corrections to the action buttons that slide into the edge of the screen.

items.text: The action buttons stay tucked away while you move between pages. A bar set to slide into its edge came back every time you switched page or view. It now only returns when you reload, bring the pointer to its edge or press ', and then stays for the time you chose.

Bring the action buttons back with ' or Shift+O and they stay. They used to slide away again after a couple of seconds, while you were still using them. Press the key again to send them off, or move the pointer over them and away — then they slide off after the time you chose, as usual.
